title: Chinese Soft Cabbage
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
tablespoon vegetable oil
2
cloves garlic, minced
450g
shredded cabbage
1
tablespoon soy sauce
1
tablespoon Chinese cooking wine (Shaoxing wine) or sherry!

tablespoon Chinese cooking wine (Shaoxing wine) or sherry!

Method:-
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large frying pan over medium heat.
Stir in the garlic, and cook for a few seconds until it begins to brown.
Stir in the cabbage until it is coated in oil; cover the wok, and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the soy sauce, and cook and stir for another minute.
Increase the heat to high, and stir in the Chinese cooking wine.
Cook and stir until the cabbage is tender, about 2 minutes more.
